_about: Campus shuttles (help desk #13, js/campus.js). The stops, routes and times are Augy's nus.json and ntu.json beside this, as he sent them. This file is what goes with them and is easy to change: each university's name and dot colour, each route's colour, NUS's term dates, and each university's credit (`credit`, linked to `creditUrl`), which the map shows only while that university's shuttles are on it. Colours are #rrggbb.

nus.name: NUS
nus._routes: From NUS's Internal Shuttle Bus network map (University Campus Infrastructure, with effect from 5 January 2026), its legend's colours, as Augy sent it on 2026-10-30. Change them here.
nus._terms: Term time, when NUS's shuttles run their term timings; any other day in `covers` is vacation, and a day outside `covers` counts as term. AY2026/27: semester 1 from orientation, 3 Aug 2026, to the end of its exams, 5 Dec 2026; semester 2 from 11 Jan 2027 to the end of its exams, 8 May 2027. From NUS's academic calendar AY2026/2027 (nus.edu.sg/registrar/docs/info/calendar/ay2026-2027.pdf) as NUS Law's weekly calendars for AY2026/27 (version of 20 July 2026, law.nus.edu.sg) set it out. Add each new year's when it's out.
nus._credit: For the route colours, from NUS's network map.
nus.credit: NUS shuttles: NUS University Campus Infrastructure

ntu.name: NTU
ntu._routes: Blue, red, green and brown, as NTU's shuttle page (ntu.edu.sg, Internal Campus Shuttle) names them; the shades are picked.
ntu.credit: NTU stops: ntu-shuttle-bus-api by Donald Wu (MIT)
